summary_en: Photography, floor plans, virtual tours and virtual staging.
summary_fr: Photo, plans, visites virtuelles et home staging virtuel.

tools.name: BoxBrownie
tools.positioning: Listing images fixed, staged and decluttered overnight, priced per image.
tools.description: BoxBrownie provides property image editing services: photo enhancement, day-to-dusk conversion, virtual staging, item removal, virtual renovation, floor plan redraws and 360 virtual tours, delivered as a per-image service with overnight turnaround.
tools.real_estate_use: An empty apartment photographs badly and a cluttered one photographs worse. Virtual staging costs a fraction of physical staging and can be ordered the evening before a listing goes live. Virtual renovation is used to show a buyer what a tired property could become — with the disclosure obligations that most markets now attach to edited images.
features: Photo enhancement and day-to-dusk conversion
Virtual staging of empty rooms
Item removal and virtual decluttering
Virtual renovation visualisations
Floor plan redraw and 3D rendering
360 virtual tour creation

use_cases.job: Stage an empty property for photography at a fraction of physical staging cost
Show a buyer the renovation potential of a tired property

tools.name: Check & Visit
tools.positioning: Inspection software combined with a field network — the report can be produced by their operator rather than by your staff.
tools.description: Check & Visit provides digital état des lieux and property visit software for French professionals, together with a network of field operators who can carry out the inspection on the manager's behalf, and 3D capture options attached to the same record.
tools.real_estate_use: For a manager with dispersed properties, the constraint on inspections is travel time, not software. Outsourcing the visit to a local operator while keeping the report in the same digital format lets a lettings team scale without hiring inspectors — and the attached 3D capture doubles as a marketing asset for the next letting.
features: Digital état des lieux with photographic evidence
Field operator network performing inspections on request
3D capture and virtual visit attached to the property record
Electronic signature and report generation
Portfolio dashboard for inspection status
Integration with management software

use_cases.job: Have inspections carried out on dispersed properties without hiring inspectors
Capture a 3D visit at the same appointment as the inspection

tools.name: CubiCasa
tools.positioning: A floor plan from a phone walkthrough — no camera, no tripod, no measuring.
tools.description: CubiCasa produces measured 2D and 3D floor plans from a smartphone video walkthrough: the user records a continuous scan, uploads it, and receives a dimensioned plan with gross living area, typically within hours.
tools.real_estate_use: Floor plans measurably improve listing engagement but traditionally required a professional visit. Because CubiCasa needs only a phone, an agent produces one during the listing appointment they were attending anyway. Appraisers use the same output for gross living area sketches that meet lender requirements.
features: Floor plan generation from smartphone video walkthrough
Measured 2D and 3D plans with room dimensions
Gross living area calculation for appraisal use
White-label ordering and delivery for enterprises
Export to common plan and imaging formats
API for high-volume ordering

use_cases.job: Produce a measured floor plan during the listing appointment with only a phone
Generate a gross living area sketch that meets lender requirements

tools.name: Matterport
tools.positioning: The 3D capture standard — a walkable digital twin that doubles as a measurable record of the space.
tools.description: Matterport captures buildings in 3D using dedicated cameras or a phone, producing walkable virtual tours, automatic floor plans, measurements and structured space data hosted on its cloud platform, embeddable in listings and other systems.
tools.real_estate_use: In marketing, a scan lets a remote buyer or tenant walk the space before travelling. In operations it does something less obvious and often more valuable: it is a dated, measurable record of condition. Property managers scan at move-in and move-out to settle deposit disputes; facility teams scan plant rooms so a contractor can measure without a site visit.
features: 3D capture from dedicated cameras or smartphone
Walkable virtual tours embeddable in listings
Automatic floor plan and measurement generation
Dated condition records for inspections and disputes
Space and asset tagging inside the model
API and integrations with listing and management platforms

use_cases.job: Let a remote buyer or tenant walk the property before travelling to see it
Hold a dated, measurable condition record for move-in and move-out disputes

tools.name: Nodalview
tools.positioning: Professional-looking property photography and virtual visits shot on the agent's own phone.
tools.description: Nodalview combines a smartphone capture application with cloud processing to produce property photography, HDR images, 360 virtual visits, videos and floor plans, plus marketing assets generated from the same shoot.
tools.real_estate_use: Hiring a photographer for every mandate is neither affordable nor fast enough in the mid-market, and phone photographs taken by an agent are usually poor. Nodalview's guided capture and automatic processing sit between the two, and because the visit and the images come from one appointment, the listing goes live the same day.
features: Guided smartphone capture with automatic HDR processing
360 virtual visits and interactive tours
Video and marketing asset generation from the same shoot
Floor plan capture options
Branded delivery and listing integration
Lead capture on shared virtual visits

use_cases.job: Produce publishable property images and a virtual visit from one phone appointment
Standardise listing image quality across a team without hiring photographers

tools.name: Previsite
tools.positioning: Suite de production et de diffusion de contenu pour agents immobiliers : photo, vidéo, visite virtuelle, site dédié au mandat et gestion des réseaux sociaux.
tools.description: Previsite publishes a set of marketing tools for real estate agents, gathered in an all-in-one mobile application called Smartpix Pro. The application produces the visual content of a listing — optimized photographs, dynamic videos and virtual tours — with the vendor stating a professional-quality result in under five minutes. Around it sit a dedicated single-property website for a mandate, and Social Connect Pro, a turnkey product that manages an agency's social accounts, distributes listings automatically and works on local visibility. Other named products include Mooveo and SpotVideo. The company is French, with offices in Hyères and Paris.
tools.real_estate_use: An independent agent who has just signed a mandate is expected to be photographer, videographer and community manager on top of the job itself. With Previsite they shoot the property on a phone through Smartpix Pro, which returns edited photos, a video and a virtual tour without a studio pass; the mandate gets its own single-property page to send to the owner as proof of work and to buyers as a landing page. Social Connect Pro then pushes the listing to the agency's social accounts on a schedule the agent does not maintain by hand, which is what keeps a small agency visible locally between listings.
features: Application Smartpix Pro regroupant photo, vidéo et visite virtuelle
Photographies optimisées et vidéos d'annonce assistées par IA
Visite virtuelle consultable à distance par l'acquéreur
Site mandat dédié à un bien
Social Connect Pro — gestion et diffusion automatique sur les réseaux sociaux
Diffusion des annonces pour la visibilité locale de l'agence

use_cases.job: Produire photos, vidéo et visite virtuelle d'un bien depuis un téléphone, sans prestataire externe
Tenir la présence de l'agence sur les réseaux sociaux avec une diffusion automatique des annonces
Donner à un mandat son propre site pour le montrer au vendeur et le servir aux acquéreurs

capabilities: Assisted video generation from listing media
